messages.subject: Robert | Global Mining & Metals Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Quinn,

I am sharing my profile for senior international mining and metals mandates where government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and country-facing leadership intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio covers senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Your leadership of Odgers' Global Mining Practice and work across mining, energy, utilities, manufacturing and infrastructure make my background directly relevant to executive searches requiring strong institutional relationships, sustainability leadership, social licence and complex stakeholder management.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my global executive CV for confidential consideration.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
